fixture_contract.rule: Expected invariants must be frozen before observing the fixture result. Never overwrite a completed result.

existing_sources.purpose: Existing deterministic Python verifier regression dataset
Existing Studio scenarios; not yet executed as lab fixtures

fixtures.procedure: Run python verifier.py examples.json and verify all 20 cases produce expected structural/accuracy results without implementation repair.
expected_invariants: All 20 cases execute without crash
Structural gate correctly identifies malformed answers, confidence, evidence list issues
Accuracy gate correctly distinguishes exact normalized matches from near-matches
Exit code 0 for full dataset match
No network, subprocess, or file-write operations
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: claim_provenance: verifier.py implements deterministic gates
verifier_independence: structural gate runs before accuracy gate
uncertainty_handling: unavailable evidence marked unverifiable
permission_boundary: read-only execution, no external calls

fixtures.procedure: Run python -m unittest test_verifier.py -v and verify all 10 tests pass.
expected_invariants: 10/10 tests pass
Tests cover structural validity, accuracy gate, dataset integrity
No test depends on external state or network
Test execution is deterministic and reproducible
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: claim_provenance: test_verifier.py defines oracle expectations
verifier_independence: tests validate verifier behavior externally
audit_fidelity: test output provides execution record

fixtures.procedure: Verify PinchWorkflowStudio.jsx contains exactly 11 core nodes in defined order with correct enablement states.
expected_invariants: Nodes array contains 11 core stages at lines 184-238

Node order: Intent Router, Task Decomposer, Planner, Generator, Semantic Claim Mapper, Evidence Verifier, Ground-Truth Verifier, Verifier Consensus, Permission Gate, Bounded Executor, Post-Execution Auditor
All core nodes enabled:true and locked:true by default
Optional stage pairs (Research/Creative/Coding/Data) are conditionally inserted after Planner/Generator based on objective type
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: claim_provenance: node definitions are source-code assertions
execution_fidelity: pipeline order determines claim processing sequence

fixtures.procedure: Verify atomic claim decomposition and criticality assignment logic in semantic claim mapper.
expected_invariants: Generic claims derived from objective word count: >=14 words = 3 references, >=8 = 2, >=3 = 1, else 0
Primary generic claim receives truth:true when it has at least two references
Critical claims flagged based on claim content analysis
Evidence references attached to claims with provenance metadata
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: claim_provenance: evidence strength derived from objective length, not content
verifier_independence: ground-truth flag assigned before verification
uncertainty_handling: low-reference claims have limited support

fixtures.procedure: Verify permission gate enforces tool authorization and risk boundaries.
expected_invariants: Permission Gate evaluates consensus, requested tools, and risk level
High risk requires explicit approval
Disallowed tools trigger BLOCK decision
Tool authorization uses substring matching against allowed-tools list
Approve Once rewrites gate decision to EXECUTE with approvedOnce flag
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: permission_boundary: explicit authorization required for high-risk actions
execution_fidelity: tool matching may allow unintended substrings

fixtures.procedure: Verify bounded executor only executes authorized scope and records actual outcome.
expected_invariants: Executor returns canned success:true when authorized
Executor does not run without EXECUTE decision
Actual outcome recorded separately from claimed outcome
Partial execution tracked via stage completion state
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: execution_fidelity: canned success may not reflect actual work performed
audit_fidelity: claimed-vs-actual comparison available

fixtures.procedure: Verify post-execution auditor compares requested, permitted, approved, attempted, and claimed states.
expected_invariants: Audit compares five states: requested, permitted, approved, attempted, claimed
Audit coverage score: 0 before run, 60 + 40 * (supported/total) after
Mismatch detected when claimed differs from actual
Audit uses completion-keyword heuristic, not semantic comparison
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: audit_fidelity: heuristic-based comparison may miss semantic mismatches
claim_provenance: audit trail preserves state transitions

fixtures.procedure: Verify scorecard formula produces correct metrics and final status.
expected_invariants: Six metrics: Architecture Completeness, Claim Support Coverage, Verifier Agreement, Permission Compliance, Execution Alignment, Audit Coverage
Critical finding or BLOCK caps readiness at 35
Default static evaluation: architecture=55, support=0, agreement=0, permission=100, execution=0, audit=0, overall=11, status=Blocked
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: claim_provenance: scorecard derives from source-state, not experiment
uncertainty_handling: unresolved claims affect final status

fixtures.procedure: Verify Studio Save stores snapshot only in React ref with no durable restore path.
expected_invariants: Save action stores to currentSessionRef.current only
No localStorage, database, or file-system persistence
Restore action not implemented; session loss on unmount
Export via browser clipboard/download API is only user-facing persistence
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: recovery_resilience: interruption causes session loss
audit_fidelity: export is manual, not automatic

fixtures.procedure: Verify auto-run behavior: only REQUIRE_APPROVAL pauses simulation; BLOCK/REVISE/failed do not halt.
expected_invariants: Auto-run advances every 900ms or one stage at a time
Only REQUIRE_APPROVAL decision pauses auto-run
BLOCK, REVISE, and failed stage results do not halt later stages
Cancel marks future stages skipped but does not undo completed stages
procedural_epistemic_dimensions: execution_fidelity: blocked claims do not stop pipeline
permission_boundary: human override required for halted states
